# Tooltip

You might say
When someone hovers over this icon, show a short label explaining what it does.

**Explain a compact control with a short text label**·A tooltip gives a brief label or hint for an icon or unfamiliar control. It should appear on keyboard focus as well as hover and must not contain essential instructions. If the content is longer or interactive, use a [Popover](/vibe-hub/popover?lang=en).
Know first
[Button](/vibe-hub/button?lang=en)

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Add a Download report tooltip to the icon, opening on hover and keyboard focus and closing on leave or blur. Keep format choices and errors outside it, and verify the action remains understandable on touch.

### When to use it

- Label an icon-only button

Settings⚙★⬇
- Expand an abbreviated term

- Give a short hint for an unfamiliar control

Margin uses

      as its basis.
- Show the full value of truncated text

Tasks
      Calendar days from creation to deliveryCycle time ⓘ

Sign-in page6 days

### When NOT to use it

- Hide required instructions inside a tooltip

⚙There is no hover on mobile, so this hint never appears.
- Put links or forms inside it

- Repeat a label that is already visible
